column1: Beat the butter and brown sugar on medium-high until smooth and creamy, then beat in the vanilla.
Add the flour and salt and mix on low, then on medium-high until the dough comes together.
If the dough stays crumbly, press it together by hand on a work surface, adding a few drops of water if needed.
Divide the dough in half and shape each piece into an 8-inch log.
Roll each log in the coarse sugar until fully coated.
Wrap the logs tightly and refrigerate at least 4 hours.
Preheat the oven to 350°F (177°C) and line two baking sheets with parchment or silicone mats.
Cut each log into 12 even slices and place 2 inches apart on the sheets.
Bake 14–16 minutes until set and lightly browned at the edges without overbaking.
Cool 5 minutes on the sheet, then move to a rack to cool completely.
